PaymentService/ProxySetupRecurring.proxy_setup_mandate: SANDBOX_NOT_PROVISIONED: run:code/07-SetupMandate.live.txt#2 - not stripe connector code. Stripe answers HTTP 402 incorrect_number to the card_proxy placeholder (no vault substitutes it in the harness environment; inferred, the bytes sent were masked), and the vault-injector branch of crates/common/external-services (service.rs:1147) returns every HTTP status as success, so the error envelope reaches the SetupMandateResponse deserializer and surfaces as RESPONSE_DESERIALIZATION_FAILED instead of a connector error. Shared framework defect, OPEN, reported in the PR body; that crate is out of scope for a connector PR.
